**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the bar by creating great guest experiences, and use every shift as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of Juicers who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You will learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path, our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**The Senior Associate Accounts Payable is responsible for ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely processing of supplier invoices and payments globally, safeguarding financial integrity and operational efficiency. The role delivers high-quality Accounts Payable execution, supports month-end and audit processes, and acts as a reliable point of contact for suppliers and internal stakeholders. As part of the Finance team, this position contributes to strong financial governance, VAT compliance, and continuous process improvement, supporting the company's scalability and commercial performance. The role is a full-time position and reports to the AP Manager.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Process and validate supplier invoices, ensuring accurate coding, proper approvals, VAT compliance, and high-quality data integrity.

• Manage supplier communication and vendor onboarding, resolving invoice and payment-related queries in a timely, structured, and service-oriented manner while coordinating effectively with internal stakeholders.

• Perform monthly reconciliations, including vendor statement reconciliations, vendor subledger reviews, and balance sheet reconciliations to ensure financial accuracy and completeness.

• Support month-end closing activities by ensuring Accounts Payable accuracy and timely reporting in line with internal controls and accounting standards.

• Contribute to audit processes by providing documentation, analysis, and reconciliation support to ensure compliance and transparency.

• Drive continuous improvement within Accounts Payable processes by identifying inefficiencies, enhancing controls, and supporting automation or standardization initiatives.

• Ensure adherence to company policies, financial controls, and regulatory requirements, maintaining strong governance within the AP function.

**KEY EXPECTATIONS

**In this role, you take ownership of your workload, manage moderately complex tasks, and help improve processes. You work independently, propose solutions, and adapt quickly when priorities shift. Your solid knowledge makes you a dependable contributor who helps drive team performance.

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

• Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

_Are you motivated by becoming the technical expert behind products and solutions that support clean water and energy? Do you thrive in a role where you connect technical development, business needs, and customer requirements? Are you excited by the opportunity to influence products throughout their entire lifecycle while collaborating with stakeholders across the organization?

**Here Is What The Job Entails

**In the role as our next Technical Product Specialist within our software applications, your job will be to provide technical expertise across the product lifecycle while ensuring that products, solutions, and technical documentation remain accurate, compliant, and competitive.

More specifically you will be:

• Acting as the technical liaison between Research and Development, Sales, Customer Service, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders

• Providing technical support including tender support, sales support, product training, and advanced troubleshooting

• Serving as the technical expert on products, configurations, software solutions, and applications

• Maintaining technical product information and documentation

• Supporting product lifecycle activities including new product development, maintenance, and phase in and phase out activities

You will experience the freedom to act and leave your mark on how we manage and support our products throughout their lifecycle. Therefore, you will work closely with technical and commercial stakeholders across the organization, gain deep insight into our products and technologies, and play a key role in ensuring knowledge sharing, product adoption, and continuous improvement.

**Meet your future team

**With direct reference to Senior Manager, Technical Product Management, you will become part of the technical product management team. As a team, we are committed to ensuring our products remain technically accurate, competitive, and capable of meeting both market and business requirements, and you will have a key role in achieving this. In the team you will experience close collaboration with colleagues across product management, development, customer service, sales, and supply chain. Together we support products throughout their lifecycle while ensuring strong stakeholder engagement and knowledge sharing across the organization.

Did you know? As a Technical Product Specialist, you will work with stakeholders from many different functions, making every day an opportunity to learn something new about our products, technologies, and customers.

**Less About Us, More About You

**We are looking for a Technical Product Specialist who is ready to take ownership of technical product activities and who is motivated by solving complex challenges. You achieve this through strong collaboration skills, technical curiosity, and a structured approach to your work.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Hold a degree in Engineering within Electronics, Software, Mechatronics, or a similar field.

• Have an understanding of product development, product lifecycle management, and technical product support

• Have experience with, or an understanding of, software-related systems such as Swagger documentation, Jira, Confluence or comparable platforms. A general end-to-end understanding of hardware and connectivity along with insights to APIsis an advantage.

• Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills combined with the ability to communicate technical information clearly

• Have experience with product related systems such as Configure Price Quote, Product Lifecycle Management, Enterprise Resource Planning, or similar platforms.

We also value experience developing and delivering technical training and knowledge sharing activities

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

**We are more than the ordinary workplace

**We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, cycle team, during our yearly summer festival or on the padel court. For example, is our Head of System Engineering and Information Technology Denmark also our volunteer padel instructor while our Software Test Engineer runs weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

• Beneficial health care and insurance package

Are you a strategic thinker who can bridge the gap between complex business goals and a high-performing IT landscape? We are looking for an Enterprise Architect to take ownership of our architectural vision and governance. In this role, you will be the guardian of our IT integrity, ensuring that every new initiative accelerates our digital transformation while staying true to our core principles.

As the owner of the Enterprise Architecture (EA) governance process, you will provide the framework that evaluates IT projects and aligns them with our long-term strategy.

**What The Job Is

**The Enterprise Architect is the strategic owner of the EA governance process. You will anticipate long-term business needs and ensure that Satair's IT model is perfectly synchronized with our organizational policies and strategies. By providing structured leadership, you will gain consensus from the management team on critical IT policy decisions, from platform selection to technology strategies, that support our overarching goals.

Your primary responsibilities:

• Process Ownership & Governance: Own the formal approach for implementing solutions. You will manage the "two-step funneling" methodology to screen new initiatives for strategic, cross-cutting, or architectural impact.

• Design Patterns & Models: Develop and promote standardized design patterns and models to ensure consistent application design and a resilient, scalable architecture across the enterprise.

• Principle Custodianship: Act as the lead custodian of Satair’s signature architecture principles, ensuring every solution adheres to these guidelines.

• Strategic Alignment & SLAs: Ensure that all IT solutions are strictly aligned with business needs and are designed to meet or exceed established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

• Documentation & Repository Management: Finalize and transfer EA-approved documents to the central repository, ensuring the Architecture Board has clear, high-quality materials for final review.

• Financial Stewardship: Produce detailed cost/benefit analyses for new technology implementations, providing the data necessary for informed investment decisions.

• Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify where software, applications, or processes need to evolve to meet the needs of tomorrow’s aviation market.

**How You Will Contribute To The Team

**The Enterprise Architect reports directly to the Head of CIO Office. In this pivotal position, you serve as a key bridge between our strategic vision and the technical execution of the IT organization. You will have a leading role in the architecture landscape, acting as the primary driver for the Architecture Board. Your work ensures that the integrity of our current technology is protected while we build the capabilities required for a secure, resilient, and sustainable future.

We are looking for a seasoned professional with a deep background in IT strategy and architecture governance. You should have a proven ability to lead through influence, gaining commitment from senior management for major technology shifts.

What you bring to the table:

• Architectural Excellence: A proven track record in developing resilient architecture models and reusable design patterns.

• Strategic Insight: The ability to perform cost/benefit evaluations that justify strategic technology choices to the CIO office and IT Management.

• Operational Focus: A commitment to ensuring technical solutions deliver on business promises and operational SLAs.

• Collaborative Leadership: Experience with EA frameworks (such as TOGAF) and the ability to navigate complex governance funnels with multiple stakeholders.

Beyond technical expertise, you are a master of communication. You can take a complex organizational challenge and translate it into a structured architectural solution. If you are ready to own the blueprint for Satair’s digital future, we’d love to hear from you.

Beyond technical skills, we value individuals who bring a collaborative mindset, excellent communication abilities, and the confidence to interact with stakeholders at all levels.

In this team, we prioritize innovation, problem-solving, and proactive thinking. If you are passionate about securing the future of aviation and enjoy working in an environment that values your expertise, we’d love to hear from you.

**What does your next challenge look like?

**At Satair, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow.

Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

**About SATAIR

**Satair offers first class material management solutions in the aftermarket business of the aviation industry. We are working to be the most customer-centric organization in providing commercial aviation spares parts to make the world continue flying. We are constantly taking customer experience to new levels by improving how we fulfill and deliver customers’ orders quickly and accurately, anywhere in the world. To meet this goal, Satair is continually striving to innovate and provide best-in-class service levels by pioneering new products and services in a fast growing business environment.

With our global functional organization spanning across 11 different sites and locations worldwide with more than 1.800 people and a turnover of $3.0 billion, you will be part of a truly global family.

Our customers have the ultimate goal to operate their fleet and our Airbus aircraft safely, efficiently in a cost-time-quality effective manner and of course with the expected comfort level for their customers. We at Satair do everything to support our customers in this.

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

**What do we offer at SATAIR?

**At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

SATAIR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We love to bring in people with different backgrounds and experiences as we believe it enhances our performance immensely!

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees in Copenhagen:

• Competitive remuneration, including short term incentive bonus on all levels

• Work/life balance: hybrid working, flex time, maternity/paternity/parental leave, 29 days of holiday + senior and flex days

• Personal development: personalized development plans, large portfolio of learning solutions and many internal mobility opportunities, both locally and globally

• Health and well-being: Health insurance, in-house canteen with many healthy options

Architect, build, and scale AI systems that hold up in production

Take ownership of how AI is architected, built, and scaled across our products. You will design the agentic systems at the core of our pension and advisory platforms, with a focus on reliable and responsible AI.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help lead our newly established AI team, working on our Life product for pension companies. The team is focused on the practical and responsible use of AI and is still in its early stages, so as a senior member you will play a defining role in setting the technical foundation, design patterns, and ways of working that the rest of the team builds on.

You will work closely with the AI Team Lead and Chief Architect, who own the overall architecture, helping shape the design within that direction. You will also be part of an agile team with a flat structure, where collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning are central to the culture.

This role is primarily about designing and building agentic and LLM systems end to end, with a meaningful share of your time spent owning how we evaluate them and prove they hold up. It suits someone with 5+ years of relevant experience who wants to move beyond implementation into designing AI systems, and who enjoys raising the bar for the engineers around them.

Why this matters

This is core infrastructure, not edge tooling. Our Life product runs policy and capital administration for some of Europe’s largest pension providers, including PensionDanmark and APG, and is on track to support more than 8 million members and over €800bn in retirement assets.

The AI you design must meet that bar: fast and innovative, but also accurate, secure, and reliable enough for systems that people depend on for their financial security in retirement. Building it well and being able to prove it works, are two sides of the same job.

What you’ll do

As a senior member of the AI team, you will help shape how we build with Large Language Models and agentic systems across our products, contributing to high‑level design decisions, turning ambiguous business problems into robust system designs, and ensuring high‑quality coding standards and design. You will be hands‑on, with a real say in the architecture, standards, and technical judgement that guide the team.

In practice, you will:

Help shape the technical direction

• Contribute to the AI tech stack across our products: help define the high‑level system design, reference architectures, and design patterns the team builds on.

• Help shape AI strategy: identify where AI can create genuine value, frame the trade‑offs, and feed into a coherent, prioritised technical roadmap that fits our wider platform.

• Inform major architectural decisions: model and framework selection, build‑versus‑buy, and how AI components fit into our existing Java platform, integrate with surrounding systems, scale, and stay maintainable over time.

• Reason about trade‑offs in the open: weigh latency, cost, accuracy, security, and reliability, and explain and defend those choices to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Architect and build (hands‑on)

• Design LLM systems end to end: from retrieval, agent orchestration, and data pipelines through to deployment and monitoring.

• Design and build agentic systems: single‑ and multi‑agent, covering orchestration, tool use, action groups, knowledge‑base integrations, and patterns such as routing, delegation, parallelisation, and result aggregation for complex, reliable production workflows.

• Engineer RAG pipelines that connect agents to internal structured and unstructured data.

• Drive quality through design: prompt strategy, system prompts, and memory systems that produce hallucination‑resistant outputs with strong relevance and faithfulness.

• Make cost‑aware architectural choices: balancing latency, cost, and quality across model selection and orchestration patterns so what we ship is sustainable at scale.

• Set the standards for prompt strategy, RAG, orchestration, and cost management that the wider team adopts.

Evaluate and prove

• Build evaluation frameworks: eval sets, golden datasets, and LLM‑as‑judge pipelines, with offline regression suites wired into CI and online evaluation on production traces.

• Evaluate the whole agent, not just the answer: task success, trajectory and tool‑use correctness, and RAG faithfulness and grounding, so you know whether failures come from retrieval, reasoning, or generation.

• Measure what gates shipping: relevance, faithfulness, latency, cost, and reliability across repeated runs, turned into quality gates the team ships against.

Collaborate and grow the team

• Collaborate and mentor: work with the AI Team Lead, Chief Architect, senior developers, and product teams to translate business needs into working, well‑tested solutions, and support more junior engineers as the team grows.

What we’re looking for

You bring a strong technical foundation, hands‑on depth with modern AI tooling, and the judgement to design systems that hold up in the real world. You don’t need deep expertise in every area below, but we do expect real depth in agentic systems and AI architecture, backed by a solid grasp of how to evaluate what you build.

Required

• A master’s degree in computer science or a similar field, preferably with an AI focus.

• 5+ years building software, with significant hands‑on work applying Large Language Models.

• Strong proficiency in a statically typed, object‑oriented language, Java or C# (we build in Java). Python is welcome for demos, evaluation tooling, and experiments, but it is not our production language.

• Deep experience designing, building, and operating agent‑based systems, with hands‑on use of one or more orchestration frameworks (e.g. LangChain/LangGraph, Microsoft Agents, Claude Agent SDK, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel).

• A track record of designing and building AI systems, including how the components fit together, scale, and are maintained over time.

• Solid, practical experience with prompt strategy, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), and the cost considerations of LLM usage and model selection.

• Working knowledge of LLM and agent evaluation: eval sets, LLM‑as‑judge, and the metrics that distinguish a good system from a confident‑but‑wrong one (faithfulness, relevance, task success, latency, and cost).

• Experience designing AI or backend systems that fit into a larger production platform, collaborating with senior engineers and architects to align on a shared technical direction.

• Strong communication skills to explain and defend architectural trade‑offs to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Nice to have

• Experience building automated evaluation pipelines or CI gates for AI systems.

• Familiarity with observability and tracing tooling for LLM applications (e.g. LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, Braintrust).

• Familiarity with LLM evaluation, automation, and red teaming.

• Broader machine learning experience.

• Hands‑on experience building and integrating MCP servers.

• Experience working in regulated or high‑reliability domains such as finance, insurance, or healthcare.

Who you are

You are a confident, hands‑on engineer who takes ownership of complex and sometimes undefined problems, and who is just as comfortable designing a system as proving it holds up. You think in systems, balance pragmatism with quality, and care about building things that work in production rather than just in a demo. You lift the people around you, stay open to feedback, and bring strong technical judgement of your own. You are curious, persistent, and result‑oriented.

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join us as a DevOps & Platform Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in building, operating, and continuously enhancing the platforms and services that drive product development, testing, validation, deployment, and operations within Siemens Gamesa’s digital ecosystem. Imagine developing automation solutions, enhancing CI/CD pipelines, and collaborating with software teams to elevate the developer experience and operational efficiency. You will work closely with product development, validation, architecture, and infrastructure teams to ensure that our platforms remain reliable, secure, and scalable. Whether you are modernizing platform services or contributing to cloud-enabled solutions, your efforts will significantly accelerate how engineering teams deliver innovative solutions. Become part of an international team that values ownership, innovation, and knowledge sharing in a culture driven by a strong engineering mindset.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Design, build, and operate platform services that support product development, testing, validation, and deployment activities.

• Develop automation solutions that enhance reliability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency.

• Strong experience with automation technologies such as Ansible, PowerShell, PowerCLI, Python, Git, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD tooling.

• Proven ability to create and maintain automation frameworks, deployment pipelines, APIs, integrations, or platform services.

• Familiarity with virtualization and platform technologies like VMware vSphere, vCenter, vSAN, ESXi, Proxmox VE, or similar enterprise platforms.

• Knowledge of Linux and/or Windows administration, scripting, troubleshooting, and system integration.

• Experience with monitoring, observability, logging, incident management, performance analysis, and service reliability practices.

• A proactive mindset with a passion for automation, continuous learning, and building reliable platform services.

Nice to Have

• Experience in Agile environments using Scrum or SAFe methodologies, along with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Git-based workflows.

• Familiarity with platform modernization, self-service platforms, developer experience initiatives, or Infrastructure as Code practices.

• Experience supporting engineering applications, industrial systems, SCADA environments, or operational technology solutions.

About the Team

You will join the Infrastructure Performance & Operations (IPO) team within Digital Products & Solutions. This team is dedicated to developing, operating, and evolving the digital platforms that support product engineering, validation, testing, and business operations across Siemens Gamesa. Our focus areas include platform engineering, automation, virtualization, CI/CD, observability, service reliability, infrastructure modernization, and operational excellence. As our digital landscape evolves, the team is also shaping future platform capabilities, cloud adoption opportunities, and next-generation Digital Foundation services. We value collaboration, technical curiosity, knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and engineers who thrive on solving complex challenges through code, automation, and modern platform engineering practices.

Would you like to contribute to ensuring high-quality pharmaceutical production while helping us simplify and improve the way we work? Do you have a strong quality mindset, excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to adapt in a changing environment?

Then this may be the opportunity for you to join API Quality M3 in Kalundborg.

Our department provides quality assurance support to six purification facilities. You will become part of a collaborative department with a strong team spirit and highly skilled, ambitious and engaged colleagues. We place great emphasis on teamwork, adaptability and continuous personal and professional development.

We are looking for an experienced QA professional who combines strong quality awareness with curiosity and an improvement mindset. You should be motivated by working in a dynamic environment where priorities and business needs may change, and where we work together to find simple, robust and compliant solutions.

Your new role

You will join one of our two QA teams responsible for supporting daily operations and projects across three purification facilities.

Your main responsibility will be to provide proactive and risk-based QA oversight of processes and documentation related to daily production. Your tasks will include:

• Reviewing batch documentation and supporting product release

• Reviewing and approving deviations, change requests, trend reports and standard operating procedures

• Providing visible and proactive QA support on the shop floor

• Supporting timely resolution of quality-related issues

• Identifying trends, risks and improvement opportunities

• Simplifying and optimizing processes while maintaining compliance and product quality

• Supporting internal audits and inspections by health authorities, including presenting relevant quality data

You will work closely with colleagues across QA, production and supporting functions. Collaboration is therefore essential, and you should enjoy sharing knowledge, asking questions and developing solutions together with others.

Digitalization and AI are becoming increasingly important in our work. You will have the opportunity to contribute to how data, digital solutions and responsibly used AI-supported tools can strengthen trend identification, improve workflows and enable more effective quality oversight. Solutions must remain compliant, transparent and supported by sound professional judgement.

The position offers opportunities to develop your professional QA capabilities and your understanding of pharmaceutical production. We support individual development through feedback, knowledge sharing, increased responsibility and involvement in improvement activities and cross-functional initiatives.

What you'll bring

We are looking for a colleague who contributes both professionally and personally to the team. To succeed in the role, we expect that you:

• Hold a relevant academic degree, for example in pharmacy, veterinary medicine or a related natural science

• Have experience from the pharmaceutical industry, preferably including at least two years within quality assurance or production

• Have a strong quality mindset and can apply a risk-based approach to case handling

• Are motivated by simplification, optimization and continuous improvement

• Are curious about digital tools and the potential responsible use of AI within quality processes

• Are adaptable and able to maintain quality and overview when priorities change

• Take responsibility for your own learning and development

• Are willing to challenge existing ways of working constructively

• Are an inclusive and dedicated team player who builds trust and respect

• Have strong collaboration and communication skills

• Are proficient in written and spoken English

About the department

Our Quality Assurance department consists of 38 dedicated employees responsible for assuring the quality and compliance of API purification processes.

We work closely with production to ensure robust processes, reliable quality oversight and timely support to daily operations. At the same time, we continuously challenge ourselves to simplify, optimize and develop the way we work.

Our culture is built on teamwork, openness and mutual support. We value different perspectives and believe that strong results are achieved when employees are given opportunities to develop, take responsibility and contribute to improvements.

Working at Novo

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

What we offer

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

jobs.occupation: PhD stipend in thermal modeling and advanced solutions for high-power modules and magnetic components
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a PhD stipend is available within the general study programme in Electrical and Electronic Engineering. The stipend is open for appointment from 1 December 2026 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years and the position is full-time.

Your work tasks
The position is offered in relation to the GreenMag project, and you will be positioned in the Section of Power Electronics Systems and Materials within the research programme Sustainable Power Electronics and Electrification (SPELL) at AAU Energy, Aalborg University. You will be based at the Aalborg campus in a highly international research environment with close collaboration with academic and industrial partners in the field of power electronics and energy systems.

The increasing electrification of transport, industry and renewable energy systems is driving the development of high-power-density power converters operating at megawatt levels. Advanced planar magnetic components are emerging as a key technology for achieving higher power density, manufacturability and integration in such converters. However, thermal management remains one of the major challenges that limit the performance, reliability and scalability of planar magnetic solutions, especially at high power and high frequency.

In this PhD project, you will work on the development of innovative thermal management technologies for megawatt planar magnetics used in future electrification systems. Your research will combine advanced modelling, experimental validation and prototype development to improve heat dissipation and thermal reliability while maintaining the required electrical and magnetic performance. You will analyse thermal behaviour and heat transfer mechanisms in high-power planar magnetic components, design and evaluate cooling concepts and contribute to the integration of these solutions in realistic converter systems.

You will conduct cutting-edge research on thermal behaviour and heat transfer mechanisms in megawatt-class planar magnetic components and use this knowledge to propose and evaluate new design strategies. You will develop multiphysics simulation models using finite element modelling tools to investigate the thermal performance of planar magnetics and to study alternative cooling concepts and material choices. You will design, manufacture and experimentally validate novel thermal management solutions for planar magnetic structures, and you will explore advanced materials and cooling technologies that can be applied in megawatt-class magnetic components. As part of the GreenMag project, you will collaborate with academic and industrial partners, disseminate your research results through publications in international journals and conferences, and contribute to teaching and supervision activities within the department as part of the PhD education programme.

Your competencies 
You have a relevant educational background within Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, Energy Engineering or a closely related field, and you hold a Master’s degree that qualifies you for enrolment in the PhD programme. You are motivated to work at the interface between thermal science, electromagnetics and power electronics, and you are interested in both theoretical and experimental research.

You bring strong analytical skills and a structured approach to modelling and problem solving, and you are comfortable working with numerical tools for thermal and multiphysics analysis. Experience with thermal analysis, power electronics or magnetic component design will be considered an advantage, as will experience with finite element analysis tools such as COMSOL Multiphysics or ANSYS. It is beneficial if you have worked with experimental testing, prototype development or laboratory work in previous projects and if you are prepared to work with both simulation and hands-on experiments in this PhD.

As a person, you are curious and creative, and you are motivated by addressing challenging research questions in collaboration with others. You are able to work independently, take responsibility for your project and contribute actively to collaborative research activities across groups and institutions. Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken, are required, as you will present your results in scientific publications, at international conferences and in meetings with project partners.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    
AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges. Aalborg University is recognised internationally for excellence in power electronics and energy systems research, and AAU has been ranked among the leading universities in Europe within energy research. At AAU Energy, you will be part of a highly international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges associated with electrification and the green transition.

The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs approximately 300 staff members from a broad range of nationalities and disciplinary backgrounds, creating a vibrant international research environment with extensive opportunities for collaboration and professional growth. The department offers world-class laboratory and workshop facilities, and maintains close collaboration with industrial partners. As a PhD student, you will have access to advanced facilities for the design, manufacturing and testing of high-power magnetic components and power electronic systems, and you will be part of an active research community in Sustainable Power Electronics and Electrification.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
• Curriculum Vitae (CV)
• Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
• Other relevant documents
The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Do you have any questions?     
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.
